agent.name: RSVP agent
agent.prompt: Call Saturday's registrants, confirm if they're coming, note whether they're bringing guests and collect every guest name.

tests.title: Happy path
tests.description: Says yes, brings one guest, gives the name

tests.title: Caller says no
tests.description: Declines, agent thanks them and ends the call

tests.title: Two plus ones
tests.description: Collect and save both guest names
